items.name: Hedge Knife
items.description: A plain single-edged knife, the kind every traveler carries for bread, rope and trouble.
items.effect: Can be thrown at a target up to ten paces away.

items.name: Shepherd's Sling
items.description: A braided cord with a leather cradle. Cheap, light and deadlier than it looks.
items.effect: Any stone you can pick up will do as ammunition.

items.name: Walking Staff
items.description: A stout length of seasoned ash, as good for the road as for cracking heads.
items.effect: +1 AC while you hold it in both hands and do nothing but defend.

items.name: Woodsman's Hatchet
items.description: A short axe with a notched handle, made for splitting kindling.
items.effect: Also works as a tool for chopping wood and clearing brush.

items.name: Ash Spear
items.description: A leaf-shaped iron head on a tall ash shaft. Simple, cheap and good at keeping foes at a distance.
items.effect: Reach: you can strike a foe one step away.
items.effect_met: +1 to attack rolls against a foe charging at you.

items.name: Hunting Bow
items.description: A short recurved bow of horn and wood, made for game in thick forest.
items.effect_met: +1 to attack rolls at short range.

items.name: Oak Round Shield
items.description: A round shield of oak planks, rimmed with iron.
items.effect: While equipped: +2 AC and -2 to attack with other weapons. It can also bash for 1d4.
items.effect_met: Raised quickly enough to turn aside most blows.
items.effect_unmet: Too heavy to bash with well: -1 to hit for each missing point of Strength.

items.name: Flanged Mace
items.description: An iron head with raised flanges that bite into armor instead of sliding off it.
items.effect_met: Your hits ignore 1 point of the target's AC from metal armor.

items.name: Arming Sword
items.description: A straight, double-edged blade with a cross guard: the dependable sidearm of soldiers and guards.
items.effect_met: +1 to rolls to parry a melee attack.

items.name: Bearded War Axe
items.description: A long-hafted axe whose hooked blade can pull a shield aside.
items.effect_met: +2 damage against shields, doors and other wooden things.

items.name: Hand Crossbow
items.description: A small crossbow that fits in one hand, popular with couriers and cutpurses alike.
items.effect_met: You can fire it with one hand while the other holds a blade.

items.name: Tallwood Longbow
items.description: A bow as tall as its archer, cut from a single stave of mountain yew.
items.effect_met: +1 damage at long range.
items.effect_unmet: -3 to attack rolls, and drawing it takes your whole turn.

items.name: Thornpoint Stiletto
items.description: A slim, triangular blade made to slip between armor plates.
items.effect_met: +2 to attack rolls against a target that has not noticed you.

items.name: Windlass Crossbow
items.description: A heavy steel-armed crossbow spanned with a hand crank. Anyone can aim it; few can carry it far.
items.effect_met: +1 to attack rolls when you brace it on a wall or rest.

items.name: Ember Wand
items.description: A rod of blackened wood with a coal-red stone at its tip, warm to the touch.
items.effect: A hit can set dry cloth, straw or wood alight.
items.effect_met: +1 damage.
items.effect_unmet: The spell fizzles and does nothing on an attack roll of 1 to 3.

items.name: Two-Hand Greatblade
items.description: A long, heavy sword swung with both hands, able to clear a path through a crowd.
items.effect_met: Your hits push lighter foes back a step.
items.effect_unmet: -3 to attack rolls, and you act last in the round.

items.name: Riverglass Sabre
items.description: A curved blade with a rippled, water-like sheen, balanced for quick cuts from horseback or on foot.
items.effect_met: +1 AC while your other hand is empty.

items.name: Rowan Ward-Rod
items.description: A rowan staff bound with silver wire, carried by hedge-wardens to shield their companions.
items.effect: Once per scene, give an ally +2 AC until your next turn.
items.effect_met: The ward gives +3 AC instead of +2.
items.effect_unmet: -2 to attack rolls, and the ward ends at the start of the ally's next turn.

items.name: Thunderglass Orb
items.description: A fist-sized sphere of smoky glass with a storm trapped inside. Its blasts can be heard a mile away.
items.effect: Every blast is deafeningly loud; stealth is out of the question.
items.effect_met: +1 to attack rolls.
items.effect_unmet: -3 to attack rolls, and you take 1d4 damage whenever you miss.

items.name: Traveler's Robes
items.description: Layered wool robes with a deep hood and more pockets than anyone needs.
items.effect: Keeps you warm and dry on the road.

items.name: Padded Jack
items.description: A quilted coat stuffed with linen and horsehair. Hot, but it softens a blow.

items.name: Hardened Leather
items.description: A jerkin of leather boiled in wax until it is stiff as wood.
items.effect_met: No penalty to sneaking or climbing.

items.name: Fernshadow Leathers
items.description: Supple leathers dyed in mottled greens and browns, favored by scouts and poachers.
items.effect_met: +2 to rolls to hide in woodland.

items.name: Studded Brigandine
items.description: A cloth coat lined with small riveted plates, a soldier's armor that does not need a squire.
items.effect_met: +1 AC against arrows and bolts.

items.name: Starthread Vestments
items.description: Robes embroidered with silver sigils that hum faintly when magic is near.
items.effect: The sigils glow softly when a spell is cast within a few paces.
items.effect_met: +1 damage with wands, rods and orbs.
items.effect_unmet: -1 to attack rolls with wands, rods and orbs.

items.name: Chain Hauberk
items.description: A knee-length shirt of riveted iron rings worn over a padded tunic.
items.effect_met: +1 AC against slashing weapons.
items.effect_unmet: -1 AC, and you tire after a few rounds of fighting.

items.name: Scale Coat
items.description: Overlapping bronze scales sewn onto a leather backing, rattling with every step.
items.effect_met: +1 AC against piercing weapons.
items.effect_unmet: -2 to attack rolls, and you move slowly.

items.name: Bastion Half-Plate
items.description: A steel breastplate, pauldrons and greaves over mail, leaving the joints free to move.
items.effect_met: +1 AC against ranged attacks.

items.name: Warden's Full Plate
items.description: A complete suit of fitted steel plate, the finest protection a smith can make.
items.effect: Takes several minutes and a helping hand to put on or take off.
items.effect_met: Critical hits against you count as normal hits.
items.effect_unmet: -3 to attack rolls, -1 AC, and you move at half speed.

items.name: Linen Bandages
items.description: A roll of clean linen for binding cuts in a hurry.

items.name: Healing Draught
items.description: A small vial of bitter red tonic that knits flesh in moments.

items.name: Burn Salve
items.description: A tin of cooling herbal paste for scorched skin.

items.name: Smelling Salts
items.description: A sharp-smelling pouch that snaps a dazed fighter back to their senses.

items.name: Courage Tonic
items.description: A fiery cordial that steadies the hand and lifts the heart.

items.name: Greater Healing Draught
items.description: A thick golden draught brewed by temple healers.

items.name: Troll-Blood Elixir
items.description: A murky green elixir; wounds close on their own for a while after drinking it.

bestiary.name: Giant Rat
bestiary.description: A dog-sized rat from the sewers and cellars.

bestiary.name: Grey Wolf
bestiary.description: A lean forest wolf; they hunt in packs.

bestiary.name: Road Bandit
bestiary.description: A cutthroat who works the trade roads.

bestiary.name: Bandit Archer
bestiary.description: Shoots from the treeline and runs when it goes badly.

bestiary.name: Bandit Captain
bestiary.description: Scarred, loud and better armed than the rest.

bestiary.name: Cave Troll
bestiary.description: A hulking grey brute that smells the living from far away.
